note: Re-judged 2026-11-06 by an independent auditor who authored none of the change; no test, record or lab ran for this judgement. RFC 4271 Section 5.1.5: "A BGP speaker MUST NOT include this attribute in UPDATE messages it sends to external peers, except in the case of BGP Confederations [RFC3065]." rfc4271_test.go changed in doc comments only and its citations are true (reactor_wire.go:536-542, the gate through localPrefAllowedTo). checkLocalPrefStrip, uncommitted in the working tree, drops requireGoBGPAttributeAbsent for waitLocalPrefWire, a stronger proof: the speaker relays the original Ze to GoBGP connection and requireLocalPrefInterval reads each frame, so code 5 on any subject UPDATE through the FIFO fence is a semantic failure at assertion 13, with session identity, all three subjects and the reverse KEEPALIVE barrier required. The old assertion could not have gone red: GoBGP v4.11.0 ProcessMessage (read from upstream) holds case *bgp.PathAttributeLocalPref ... if !external, with external true for this non-RS-client peer, so the RIB never showed a leak, as the checker's comment says. The scenario's injector is internal and sends LOCAL_PREF 200, so a strip is owed. TestLocalPrefStripChecksDestinationWire reddens leaked200, leaked0, truncated, wrong connection and missing fence with an unchanged RIB, by its own words checker-boundary evidence and no native run. Bound: no native run of the rewritten checker was seen here and it carries no discrimination record. The unit proofs stand without it: TestRFC4271LocalPrefOmittedForExternalPeers, TestForwardLocalPrefStrippedToExternalPeer, TestForwardLocalPrefStripBeatsAFilterSet. Confederation exception: localPrefAllowedTo holds it constantly false and no YANG module configures a member AS, so it cannot apply. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgements are in this file's git history.
